brief:
The Guardian reports that NAZA, an award-winning documentary by Israeli filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor about Israel's mass killing of civilians in Gaza, will receive a theatrical release across 56 territories. The film has already garnered critical acclaim and won multiple awards.

Following its theatrical rollout, NAZA will stream on the Guardian website, expanding its reach beyond cinema audiences to a global digital audience.
